speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: It would be really helpful if you donated to Save the Children fund!

speaker: A2T007HZK66WM
text: What does the money go towards if I donate?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: When crisis strikes and children are most vulnerable, we are always among the first to respond and the last to leave. We ensure children's unique needs are met and their voices are heard. We deliver lasting results for millions of children, including those hardest to reach. We do whatever it takes for children ¡ª transforming their lives and the future we share ¡ª because we believe every child deserves a future.

speaker: A2T007HZK66WM
text: Where in the world are the children located?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: US and global, wherever children need help, they are there.

speaker: A2T007HZK66WM
text: If I donate $25, does that go a long way?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: Absolutely, a small amount of money for us turns out to be life changing for those in need. A dollar can buy a lot!

speaker: A2T007HZK66WM
text: Will it help towards education?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: Yes, it is one of the core programs. It leads children out of poverty so is a large focus.

speaker: A2T007HZK66WM
text: Do you accept monthly donations of smaller amounts?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: You can do a one time donation or a monthly subscription.

text: What are the amounts for monthly subscriptions?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1

text: Do I get updates on a specific child if I donate monthly?

text: Yes you can sponsor a child and receive specific information about what your money is doing and how they are progressing each month.

speaker: A2T007HZK66WM
text: To what age are children receiving help?

speaker: A125KW9P18V5Z1
text: From infants to young adults all children are helped.

text: Thank you, that is wonderful and you will help a tremendous amount!
